name: button
summary: Buttons trigger actions. The default (primary) variant is the single most important action on a surface.
useWhen: You need to trigger an action — submit, confirm, start a flow — rather than navigate to a page.
You need an icon-only action trigger (use an icon size with an aria-label).

alternatives.name: button-group
alternatives.when: several related actions belong together as one segmented control.

alternatives.name: toggle
alternatives.when: the control switches a state on/off rather than firing an action.

rules.do: Use one default (primary) button per surface, for the single most important action.
rules.dont: Scatter several primary buttons on one surface — they compete and none reads as primary.

rules.do: Leave the focus ring on --ring, the accent-driven ink ring.
rules.dont: Restyle the focus ring with a hardcoded pigment such as terracotta.

rules.do: When the action goes to another page, render a real anchor (or your router's Link), styled with the button's link variant if it should look like one.
rules.dont: Navigate from a button onClick — it cannot be opened in a new tab and announces as a button, not a link.

rules.do: Give every icon-only button an explicit aria-label.
rules.dont: Ship an icon-only button with no accessible name.

a11y: Native <button> semantics: Enter and Space activate; disabled removes it from the tab order.
Icon-only sizes (icon, icon-xs, icon-sm, icon-lg) require an aria-label.
The focus ring uses --ring and must stay visible on every theme ground.
